Karnataka High Court Quashes Order on Rescued Dogs

The Karnataka High Court has overturned a previous order that mandated the return of rescued dogs to an alleged abuser. The court stated that "animals are not chattels," emphasizing their status beyond mere property. This decision highlights a legal perspective on animal welfare and the treatment of animals in judicial proceedings. Another ruling by the Karnataka High Court affirmed that law cannot be used to criminalize affection between consenting adults.
